title: A Blessing From Mahavatar Babaji | Sri Daya Mata

# A Blessing From Mahavatar Babaji

### Opening Reflections

My dear ones, as we sit together in the silence of this temple, I feel the presence of our beloved Guru, Paramahansa Yogananda. In his teachings, he brought us the direct lineage of the masters—the unbroken chain that leads back to the deathless Mahavatar Babaji. Many of you have asked me over the years about the reality of the Great Master. Is he a myth? Is he a legend? I tell you, with the certainty of one who has walked the path he illuminated, that he is a living, breathing reality, watching over every soul who turns to the divine.

### The Nature of Babaji's Guidance

Babaji represents that eternal, unchanging consciousness that upholds the universe. He does not seek recognition; he seeks only the awakening of the soul. When we practice the techniques of Kriya Yoga that he brought to this age, we are not just performing a ritual; we are establishing a resonant frequency with his consciousness. He is the hidden gardener of the spiritual path. When we stumble, he is there, unseen, gently nudging our consciousness back toward the light.

**Story • The Silent Presence in the Cave**

Story: I remember Paramahansaji sharing with us stories of the Himalayan masters. He spoke of a seeker who had traveled for months through treacherous mountain passes, driven by a singular, burning desire to see Babaji. The seeker finally reached a secluded cave, exhausted, hungry, and near death. He sat there, his mind racing with frustration, feeling he had failed because he saw no one. Suddenly, a soft voice whispered from the shadows of the cave, 'Your desire was not for me, but for the satisfaction of your own ego. You sought a vision, but I am the vibration that exists between your breaths.' The seeker was silent, and in that silence, he realized that to see the Master was not to see a form, but to become that stillness. He left the cave transformed, not by a meeting, but by an understanding.

### The Role of Devotion

Devotion is the fuel for our spiritual journey. Without it, the intellect remains a dry, barren landscape. We must learn to love God with the same intensity that the thirsty man desires water. When we reach this level of longing, Babaji’s blessing descends not as a distant miracle, but as an internal transformation. It is a refinement of our soul’s perception.

### Living the Teachings

We must ask ourselves: How do we carry this blessing into our daily lives? It is easy to be spiritual in the temple, but the true test is the marketplace, the office, and the home. Can we remain centered when the world around us is in chaos? This is where Babaji’s training comes in. He teaches us through the discipline of Kriya to remain like the lotus flower—rooted in the mud of the world, yet blooming above the surface, untouched by the impurities around us.

### Concluding Invocation

Let us deepen our meditation. Let us offer our hearts as a living altar. Know that you are never alone. Whether you are in the quiet of your room or the bustle of the city, the lineage is with you. May you feel the touch of the Infinite. May the grace of Mahavatar Babaji guide you through the darkness of ignorance into the blazing light of divine realization.
